defs.def: a man who has people working for him, often as servants in his home （男）主人，雇主
a person who is able to control sth 主宰；主人；有控制力的人

ex.s: Christopher Parker No man is free who is not master of himself.
ex.t: 克里斯托弗·帕克：不能掌控自己的人不是自由的人。

ex.s: Christopher Parker c No man is free who is not master of himself.
ex.t: 克里斯托弗·帕克 c 不能掌控自己的人不是自由的人。

defs.def: a person who is skilled at sth 能手；擅长 … 者
the male owner of a dog 狗的男主人
a male teacher at a school, especially a private school （尤指私立学校的）男教师
a second university degree, or, in Scotland, a first university degree, such as an MA 硕士学位（大学的中级学位；在苏格兰指初级学位）
a person who has a master's degree 硕士；有硕士学位的人

ex.s: You are studying in a graduate program for a master's degree．
ex.t: 你正在攻读硕士学位的研究生项目中学习。

ex.s: hold a master's degree in science

defs.def: the captain of a ship that transports goods （货船的）船长
a famous painter who lived in the past （已故）著名画家，绘画大师

ex.s: Wang Wei decided to sponsor the young man to study painting and recommended him to a master.
ex.t: 王维决定资助这位年轻人学习绘画，并把他推荐给了一位大师。

defs.def: a version of a record, tape, film/movie, etc. from which copies are made 常用作形容词
a title used when speaking to or about a boy who is too young to be called Mr (also used in front of the name on an envelope, etc.) （对年龄小而不便称作“先生”的男孩的称谓；也用在信封等处的人名前）少爷，君
(in Britain) the title of the head of some schools and university colleges （英国）校长，院长
a title used for speaking to or about some religious teachers or leaders （对宗教导师或领袖的称谓）大师，师傅

ex.s: Masters of Time In the quiet courtyards of Xi San Suo, behind the high walls of the Forbidden City, time ticks at its own pace.
ex.t: 时间的大师：在紫禁城高墙后面西三所的宁静庭院里，时间以它自己的节奏滴答作响。

ex.s: If it hadn’t been for a three-episode documentary, outsiders would never have known that the plainly-dressed people working here are masters of their craft, who have spent their lives restoring precious antiques.
ex.t: 如果没有三集纪录片，外人永远不会知道在这里工作的穿着朴素的人是他们的手艺大师，他们一生都在修复珍贵的古董。

defs.def: to learn or understand sth completely 精通；掌握

ex.s: That is the only French phrase I mastered, and it’s a shame I don’t have much use for it.
ex.t: 那是我唯一掌握的法语短语，遗憾的是我没什么机会用到它。

ex.s: Here are some principles you must master.
ex.t: 这里有一些你必须掌握的原则。

ex.s: There is a great deal of pressure to master one's field.
ex.t: 要精通自己的领域，压力非常大。

defs.def: to manage to control an emotion 控制（情绪）

ex.s: Turner wisely said that “doing well” psychologically is being able to roll with the flow of emotions, manage them, communicate clearly and well with others, and master various skills.
ex.t: 特纳明智地说，“从心理上讲”“做得好”是能够顺应情绪的流动，管理情绪，与他人清晰良好地沟通，并掌握各种技能。“

defs.def: to gain control of an animal or a person 控制（动物或人）
（描述精于某职业的人）熟练的，灵巧的，有技能的
the largest and/or most important 最大的；最重要的

不 主人 的 的反身形式
